name: Bohemian Web
summary: Earth tones, hand-drawn florals, macramé and woven patterns, arched shapes, warm photography and relaxed script type. It shows a free-spirited, natural and craft-based taste.

philosophy.core_thesis: The page is a lived-in, free-spirited space: natural, layered and warm.
design_principles: Build the palette from 4 to 6 earth tones (terracotta, sand, sage, mustard, plum) with saturation of 25% to 55%.
Use arches as the main shape: image masks with a top radius of 999px and a bottom radius of 0 to 24px.
Layer 2 to 4 pattern fills (floral, macramé, ikat, dots) at 8% to 20% opacity behind sections.
Pair a warm serif display at 48px to 88px with a script accent at 28px to 40px and a humanist sans at 16px.
Set photography warm (colour temperature +10% to +20%) with grain of 3% to 6% and natural light.
Add organic dividers: a wavy line of 2px to 3px or a scalloped edge of 16px to 24px.
Keep corners soft: radius of 16px to 32px on cards and 999px on tags.
anti_patterns: Sharp corners and heavy black borders

layout.grid_mechanics: A relaxed grid of 12 columns; images in arches overlap text blocks by 16px to 48px; sections change ground colour.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 35% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 48 and 96px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings with scripts; text blocks flush left; images and tags set off-grid.
layout.container_geometry: Arches, rounded rectangles of 16px to 32px, circles and scalloped edges.

font_pairings.note: A soft serif for long headings.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 for display and body and 600 for labels.
Set script words at the size of the display or larger.
Set sentence case in headings with one script accent word.

color.palette_structure: Warm earth with sage and a touch of plum.
color.contrast_rules: Bark on sand holds 11:1; white text only on clay at 18px and larger; sage fills carry no small text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat earth tones with a grain of 3% to 6% and pattern fills at 8% to 20%.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft, warm and low: 0 8px 24px at 12% in brown.

materiality.surface_simulation: Linen, clay, dried grass and woven cotton.
materiality.border_rules: No hard border; a 1px sand line or a scalloped edge.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Shadow 0 8px 24px at 12% in brown; no blur on content.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Hand-drawn 2px icons with round caps: sun, moon, leaf, feather.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Arched photos, dried flowers, macramé, rugs and hand-drawn botanicals.

motion.transition_physics: Gentle: items fade up 12px in 600ms; arches scale from 0.96; no springs.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a card 4px and warms its photo by 5%; active state returns it.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels welcomed into a warm, free and natural home.

avoid_when: The brand needs a precise or technical tone.
The page is dense with data.
The audience expects a corporate look.

modifiers.how: Lighten the palette to pastels and use light type with more air.
Add tape, photos and tilted paper.
Use flowing lines, a floral border and a gold accent.

pack.why: A soft, rounded family with a two-tone fill that suits warm, crafted layouts.

ground.why: Bohemian pages sit on warm hand-made paper with soft washes of dyed colour.

tailwind.classes: rounded-full bg-[#B84A33] px-7 py-3 font-semibold text-white transition duration-[600ms] hover:-translate-y-1
